text:
morgan: heads-up — coordinated cutover in 28m. targets: API=v3.2.0, runtime=kernel-qt2.2, console=6.3.0, router=header-passthrough-v1. plan: warmup 2% -> canary 10% -> pause at 30% for KV/auth checks -> ramp 70% -> 100%. manual holds at 10% and 30%. any blockers?

alex: +1. please insert a 3m observation after 70% before final ramp. previous kernel bumps created p99 spikes on long prompts.

emily: console will flip asset-flag at +9m and set CDN TTL=30s for 20m. rolling name in release notes: "header-passthrough + assets". console rollback requires CDN purge (~3-6m).

tarun: security note — CSP header change included in this console patch. router needs header whitelist update or we risk blocked reports from some clients. i'll coordinate with sasha.

sasha: i'll watch router header passthrough logs during 10% canary. if header loss >0.25% revert router immediately. also confirm router canary percentages.

jay: observability setup: three canary probes (/health, /v1/chat/ping, /v1/embeddings/ping). rollback triggers: p95 latency >160ms OR error rate >0.8% sustained 90s -> auto rollback. i'll post metrics after each stage.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by morgan: "crosssvc-8101112222". scheduled start in 28m. pins applied: API=3.2.0, Runtime=kernel-qt2.2. PAUSE_AT_10 and PAUSE_AT_30 configured with manual gates. rollback window: 60m after completion. To cancel: `/deploy cancel crosssvc-8101112222`. Manual resume: `/deploy resume crosssvc-8101112222`. Streaming status to this thread.

morgan: rollback order confirmation: runtime -> api -> router -> console. exception: if CSP/header breaks client flows, router first. runtime rollback target: kernel-qt2.1; api rollback v3.1.x; router revert header-passthrough; console -> 6.2.x.

\alex: runtime-first reduces kernel-specific tokenization stalls. agree with the order.

emily: console team will be ready to purge CDN if needed. set me as primary for console rollback ops.

\tarun: i'll push the whitelist change to a canary rule so router canary carries the header mapping. if we see CSP violations in Sentry/edge logs >0.1% I'll flag here.

\sjay: preflight at T-6: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r '.status'` and `curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep -i x-runtime-kernel`. also quick load: `hey -z 10s -q 40 -c 8 https://api.redwood.test/chat` to check tail.

alex: add quick token test: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.test/user/profile | jq .id` to ensure auth passthrough intact.

morgan: who will run T-5 smoke and post results? @jay @sasha

jay: i'll run T-5 smoke and post a one-line: `health:ok, kernel:kernel-qt2.1, p95:82ms, errors:0.03%`. will run the token check and header grep.

sasha: i'll run header checks and confirm CSP passthrough before approving 10% resume. need alex or tarun to approve 30% gate.

deploy-bot: NOTE: PAUSE_AT_10 and PAUSE_AT_30 are enforced. PAUSE_AT_10 timeout 8m, PAUSE_AT_30 timeout 10m. Auto-abort conditions attached to rollback triggers listed above.

morgan: add manual rule — require both alex and sasha approval to resume at 30%.

alex: ack. i'll only approve if p95 < 120ms and no auth errors.

tarun: ack. i'll approve if CSP logs show <0.05% violations and no new satis failures.

emily: one more: console rollback sequence will clear edge caches then toggle flag. expect ~4-6m to see client effect. document that in the runbook.

jay: copied. i'll stream canary outputs at each step. planning commands during canary: `curl -sS -H "x-canary: true" -I https://api.redwood.test/health` and then `jq` on the body for kernel header.

morgan: thanks all. i'll kick at scheduled time and post each stage here. ping this thread to request an immediate rollback. :rocket:
